notes: File hashes cover data/raw, data/processed, data/pretrained, and data/source.
The manifest itself is excluded from the file list to avoid a self-referential hash.
Raw public datasets remain local; use the download and preparation scripts to recreate them.

ade.notes: The upstream mirror alone does not recreate the project-preserved train/test JSONL files.

prsm.notes: The train/test CSV manifests provide file mappings and SHA-256 values.

ir.notes: The archive hash in this manifest pins the local download used by the project.

e5.notes: The local file SHA-256 values pin the downloaded model files.

source_tables.notes: These are fixed analysis inputs used by the reported figures and summaries.
